commitResults.messageTitle: Renaming the chat bot and modifying the ASCII art
Updated gitignore as well as added mark function

commitResults.messageBody:
Task state is represented in separate arrays and default-package classes.

Keeping task data and behavior together makes the code easier to extend as the task model grows.

Move GoatBot and Task into the goatbot package. Store tasks in a Task array and use Task methods to mark, unmark, and display task status.

This follows the project Java coding standard by using package declarations, private fields, constants, and Javadocs for public classes and nontrivial methods.

Project guidance does not identify the Java style rules that future code edits should follow.

Make the SE-EDU Java coding standard explicit in AGENTS.md so future Java changes use the project-specific skill.

Project guidance does not name the convention to use when future commits are proposed or created.

Require the project-specific SE-EDU Git standard in AGENTS.md so commit messages and related Git work follow the same rules going forward.

Task fields are implementation details that other classes do not need to modify directly.

Make the fields private and final where possible so each task controls its own state. Name the status icons as constants to make the display intent clearer.

The main method mixes command routing, parsing details, and output formatting in one long block.

Extract focused helper methods so the command loop reads at one level of abstraction. This improves readability while keeping the visible text UI behavior unchanged.

Code changes can affect the text UI output that is checked by the local UI test plan.

Record the expectation that relevant UI test cases are updated before running the test-ui skill after each code update. This keeps future changes aligned with the project's testing workflow.

The Week 4 workflow uses project-specific Codex guidance and skills to support reviews, coding standards, and UI testing.

Remove the .codex ignore rule and commit the local Codex files so the testing and guidance setup is recorded with the project.

The UI test plan includes captured banner art that appears as question marks on Windows terminals.

Ignore banner-art-only lines during UI test comparison and remove them from the expected outputs. This keeps the tests focused on meaningful text while preserving exact checks for the rest of the session.

Goat Bot needs a checked exception for input errors that can be shown to the user and recovered from.

Introduce GoatBotException so parsing and command handling can report controlled failures without using generic runtime exceptions.

Task parsing is mixed into the main command loop.

Move todo, deadline, and event parsing into Parser so input format checks live in one place. Throw GoatBotException when malformed task input should be rejected.

Task storage still lives in GoatBot, but the task list state is ready to be separated during the next refactor.

Add a small TaskList class with task storage fields so future changes have a clear place to move list operations.

The command loop should continue after malformed input instead of letting parser failures stop the program.

Call Parser for task creation commands and catch GoatBotException inside each loop iteration. Validate mark and unmark task numbers before mutating task state.

The UI test plan needs coverage for malformed commands mixed with valid commands.

Add edge cases for unknown commands, empty todos, invalid task numbers, and malformed deadline or event commands to verify failed inputs do not corrupt task state.

Goat Bot classes live in one package, which makes responsibilities harder to see as the project grows.

Move parser, exception, and task-related classes into focused subpackages while keeping GoatBot as the entry point. This keeps the package layout aligned with each class responsibility without changing user-visible behavior.

The fixed-size array requires manual capacity and counter management.

Store tasks in a dynamically sized ArrayList and derive counts from its
size so task operations remain consistent.

Users need to remove tasks that are no longer relevant.

Parse and validate a one-based task number, remove the matching task,
and display the updated task count. Document command helpers and add a
UI test that verifies deletion and task renumbering.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save tasks after each list change
commitResults.messageBody:
Task changes are lost when the chatbot exits.

Write the complete task list after each successful add or status update.
Use a pipe-separated format so records can be loaded later.

commitResults.messageTitle: Load tasks when Goat Bot starts
commitResults.messageBody:
Saved tasks are unavailable after restarting the chatbot.

Read pipe-separated records at startup and reconstruct each task with its
completion state. Isolate UI test runs so saved files do not leak between
test cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: update to flexible path for various Operating Systmes

commitResults.messageBody: Combine Level 6 ArrayList and delete behavior with Level 7 file persistence. Save tasks after each list change and reload them when Goat Bot starts.

Goat Bot needs a portable artifact that runs without manually configuring its classpath. Add the Gradle wrapper and Shadow configuration for Java 25, use a Windows-safe ASCII banner, and keep the UI tests aligned with the new output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use ASCII art for welcome banner
commitResults.messageBody: The Unicode banner does not render reliably in some Windows terminals. Replace it with portable ASCII art and keep the text UI expectations aligned with the new output.
Add the version-controlled Gradle wrapper and Shadow configuration so the fat JAR can be reproduced from master while keeping generated JAR and task data out of Git.

commitResults.messageTitle: update ASCII art to look more visually appealing
Update UI tests for welcome banner
commitResults.messageBody: The welcome banner now uses a shorter divider. Update every UI test expectation so it matches the current console output.
